neural_operations.block: pre-LayerNorm; causal multihead attention; residual; pre-LayerNorm; MLP; residual
neural_operations.attention: qkv Linear; contiguous heads; softmax(q k^T / sqrt(head_width)); causal mask; output Linear
neural_operations.readout: final LayerNorm; unembedding Linear without bias; softmax
neural_operations.embedding: token embedding plus learned absolute position embedding
neural_operations.linear_weights: out_features by in_features; biases included when present
neural_operations.alignment: probabilities[:, t] predicts tokens[:, t] from BOS and tokens[:, :t]
neural_operations.activations: final normalized residual at each prediction position, when supplied
